Summertime Sweets

August 11, 2026 by Bakerella

 

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:23
Instaread

Hey friends! I pulled together a bunch of sweet treats that would be super fun served up this summer. Check these out if you are looking for a cute treat to bake and get you ready for all the warm weather fun on the horizon.

Let’s dive in.

 

Lemonade Cupcakes

It’s like biting into sunshine! These lemon cupcakes are a fun take on your favorite summertime drink.

Beach Ball Cake Pops

Have a ball (literally) with these happy, colorful cake pops.

Ice Cream Cupcakes

I made these cuties for Valentine’s Day, but they are perfect for summer, too. And they last longer out in the hot sun, to boot.

Sugar Cookie Sunnies

Say hello to summer with these adorable sugar cookie sunnies.

Hello Sunshine Cake Pops

These are the cheeriest treats and bring big smiles to anyone they meet.

 

Snow Cone Cupcakes

You don’t have to worry about these melting by the pool. That is all buttercream frosting covered in sugar crystals for a faux frozen treat.

Easy Oreo Ice Cream Sandwiches

These make a big impact with little effort. Oreo Sandwich cookies + an assortment of ice cream flavors = lots of fun!

 

French Fry Cookies

Serve these up to celebrate the start of summer in a sweet way.

Lei Time

Well hello there, cupcake! These tropical treats would be so much fun for a luau party.

Pupsicles

These teeny-tiny treats are doggone cute and a would definitely brighten up the the long, hot dog days of summer.

Sundae Funday Cupcakes

A buttercream explosion of over-the-top color and fun!
